air-purifier-area.name: Air Purifier Coverage Area Calculator
air-purifier-area.intro: Estimate the suitable room area of an air purifier from its CADR value and an applicable factor, so you can match a model to your room size.

assessor-water-quality.name: Water TDS Quality Assessor
assessor-water-quality.intro: Rate water quality by TDS (total dissolved solids) against threshold bands, also weighing temperature and intended use such as drinking, brewing or aquarium.

battery-capacity-wh.name: Battery Capacity Converter (Ah to Wh)
battery-capacity-wh.intro: Convert battery capacity between amp-hours and watt-hours (Wh = Ah x V) and estimate the runtime it gives under a given load.

battery-life.name: Battery Runtime Calculator
battery-life.intro: Estimate how long a battery lasts from its capacity, voltage, load power and conversion efficiency, reported in hours or days.

calculator-calc-4.name: Noise Decibel Addition Calculator
calculator-calc-4.intro: Combine several sound pressure levels into one total level using logarithmic addition L = 10 log10 of the summed 10 to the Li over 10 terms.

calculator-calc-5.name: Heat Pump COP Calculator
calculator-calc-5.intro: Work out the coefficient of performance of a heat pump in heating or cooling mode from its capacity and electrical power input.

calculator-calc-power-usage.name: Tiered Electricity Tariff Calculator
calculator-calc-power-usage.intro: Compute a household electricity bill under tiered pricing by summing the energy falling in each tier multiplied by that tier's rate.

carbon-footprint.name: Carbon Footprint Calculator
carbon-footprint.intro: Estimate annual personal or household carbon emissions in kgCO2e from electricity, gas, driving, flights and public transport.

carnot-efficiency.name: Carnot Efficiency Calculator
carnot-efficiency.intro: Compute the maximum theoretical efficiency of a heat engine from cold and hot reservoir temperatures using eta = 1 minus Tc over Th.

conductive-heat-rate.name: Conductive Heat Transfer Rate Calculator
conductive-heat-rate.intro: Compute steady-state conductive heat flow Q = k A dT over d from thermal conductivity, area, temperature difference and thickness.

convert-emission.name: Greenhouse Gas Emission Converter (CO2e)
convert-emission.intro: Convert greenhouse gas masses into CO2 equivalent using global warming potential values for the common gases.

cop-heatpump.name: Heat Pump COP from Heat Output and Power Input
cop-heatpump.intro: Compute the coefficient of performance of a heat pump directly from delivered heat and electrical power input, plus the derived running cost.

daily-irradiation.name: Daily Solar Irradiation Calculator
daily-irradiation.intro: Compute daily solar irradiation from peak irradiance and equivalent sunshine hours, for photovoltaic sizing and yield estimates.

electrical-power.name: Electrical Power Calculator (P = V x I)
electrical-power.intro: Compute DC electrical power from voltage and current, with the derived resistance and the energy used over a given time.

energy-calculator.name: Energy and Environment Calculator
energy-calculator.intro: Convert between energy units and estimate consumption and carbon emissions from electricity, gas, mileage and fuel inputs.

energy-consumption.name: Energy Consumption Calculator
energy-consumption.intro: Compute energy use E = P x t from appliance power and running time, together with the corresponding electricity cost.

energy-cost.name: Electricity Cost Calculator
energy-cost.intro: Compute electricity cost from power rating, hours of use and the unit tariff, including daily, monthly and yearly totals.

energy-density.name: Energy Density Calculator
energy-density.intro: Compute energy density as energy divided by mass, so batteries and fuels can be compared on a like-for-like basis.

energy-efficiency.name: Energy Efficiency Calculator (COP, EER, SEER)
energy-efficiency.intro: Compute efficiency ratios such as COP, EER and SEER from output and input energy, and translate them into running cost.

energy-from-power.name: Electrical Energy Calculator (E = P x t)
energy-from-power.intro: Compute electrical energy in kWh, MJ or J from power and duration, and convert between the common energy units.

energy-payback.name: Energy Investment Payback Calculator
energy-payback.intro: Compute the payback period of an energy-saving investment from its initial cost and annual savings, plus the simple return rate.

estimate-area.name: Solar Power Output Estimator
estimate-area.intro: Estimate annual solar generation from roof area, sunshine hours, module efficiency and system efficiency, with a revenue estimate.

estimate-time-current.name: Battery Charging Time Estimator
estimate-time-current.intro: Estimate charging time from battery capacity, charge current, voltage, efficiency and the starting state of charge.

fridge-power-estimator.name: Refrigerator Energy Use Estimator
fridge-power-estimator.intro: Estimate a refrigerator's daily and yearly energy use from its volume, efficiency grade, ambient temperature and electricity price.

fuel-cost.name: Fuel Cost Calculator
fuel-cost.intro: Compute fuel cost from consumption, or from distance and fuel economy, and the unit fuel price, including cost per 100 km.

fuel-heat-value.name: Fuel Calorific Value Energy Calculator
fuel-heat-value.intro: Compute the heat released by a fuel from its mass and lower heating value, and compare fuels by their energy content.

heat-energy-q.name: Heat Energy Calculator (Q = m c dT)
heat-energy-q.intro: Compute the heat needed to change a substance's temperature from its mass, specific heat capacity and temperature rise.

heat-pump-cop.name: Heat Pump COP and EER Calculator
heat-pump-cop.intro: Compute COP and EER for heating and cooling from output and input values, and estimate the running cost over a season.

joule-heating.name: Joule Heating Power Calculator (P = I squared R)
joule-heating.intro: Compute resistive heating power from current and resistance, with the energy delivered and the temperature-rise context.

lcoe.name: LCOE Levelised Cost of Electricity
lcoe.intro: Compute the levelised cost of electricity from capital cost, lifetime, discount rate, operation and maintenance, and annual generation.

power-consumption.name: Household Power Consumption Calculator
power-consumption.intro: Compute total household electricity use and the resulting bill from appliance power, daily hours, days and the tariff.

power-factor-calc.name: Power Factor Calculator
power-factor-calc.intro: Compute power factor PF = P over S from active and apparent power, together with reactive power and the phase angle.

r-value-insulation.name: Insulation R-Value Calculator
r-value-insulation.intro: Compute thermal resistance R = d over k from material thickness and thermal conductivity, for wall and roof insulation design.

solar-calculator.name: Solar Power Generation Calculator
solar-calculator.intro: Estimate annual photovoltaic generation and payback from installed power, area, efficiency, electricity tariff and subsidy.

solar-output-physics.name: Solar PV Output Calculator (P = A G eta)
solar-output-physics.intro: Compute photovoltaic output power from panel area, irradiance and conversion efficiency by the physical power equation.

solar-panel-power.name: Solar Array Power Calculator
solar-panel-power.intro: Compute the instantaneous power of a photovoltaic array from total area, irradiance and module efficiency, with daily energy.

specific-energy.name: Specific Energy Calculator
specific-energy.intro: Compute specific energy as energy per unit of mass so that storage media and fuels can be compared directly.

standby-power-calculator.name: Standby Power Calculator
standby-power-calculator.intro: Sum the standby consumption of appliances, power multiplied by hours, to reveal the yearly cost of always-on devices.

thermal-efficiency.name: Thermal Efficiency Calculator
thermal-efficiency.intro: Compute thermal efficiency as useful output divided by energy input, with losses and the fuel cost per unit of useful energy.

three-phase-power.name: Three-Phase Power Calculator
three-phase-power.intro: Compute three-phase active power P = square root of 3 times U times I times cos phi from line voltage, current and power factor.

water-tds-evaluator.name: Water TDS Evaluator
water-tds-evaluator.intro: Enter a TDS reading in ppm to see the water quality band and whether the water suits drinking, cooking or appliances.

wind-power-estimator.name: Wind Turbine Power Estimator
wind-power-estimator.intro: Estimate wind turbine output from wind speed, blade radius, air density and power coefficient, with annual energy production.

wind-power-physics.name: Wind Power Calculator (P = half rho A v cubed)
wind-power-physics.intro: Compute the power available in the wind from air density, swept area and wind speed by the physical wind power equation.
